def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the interior of each rectangular hollow frame. Odd-sized holes
    # become 7; even-sized holes become 2.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in set(x for row in grid for x in row):
        rs = [r for r in range(h) if c in grid[r]]
        cs = [j for j in range(w) if any(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h))]
        if len(rs) < 2 or len(cs) < 2:
            continue
        t, b, l, rr = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        # A frame is a fully colored rectangular perimeter.
        if (all(grid[t][j] == c and grid[b][j] == c for j in range(l, rr + 1)) and
            all(grid[r][l] == c and grid[r][rr] == c for r in range(t, b + 1))):
            ih, iw = b - t - 1, rr - l - 1
            fill = 7 if ih % 2 == 1 else 2
            for r in range(t + 1, b):
                for j in range(l + 1, rr):
                    out[r][j] = fill
    return out
